records.label: spacr.qt.live_zoom#8
records.source: AND THE ICONS DID NOT MOVE AT ALL, which was NOT part of that compromise. The spacing caught up at the settle; the icons never caught up, because an icon size is neither a stylesheet value nor a ``scaled_px`` call that anything re-ran -- it is a widget PROPERTY written once when the widget was built, so a scale that grew every caption left every glyph beside those captions exactly where it was. The settle now re-derives them, through :func:`spacr.qt.preferences._rescale_icon_sizes`, inside the same ``apply_preferences_to_app`` step that rebuilds the sheet: 5.5 ms for the 2,122 widgets of a window with two modules open, against the 395-877 ms that step costs when the scale really changes. Nothing was added to the live half.
records.context: And the icons did not move at all, which was NOT part of that compromise. The spacing caught up at the settle; the icons never caught up, because an icon size is neither a stylesheet value nor a ``scaled_px`` call that anything re-ran -- it is a widget PROPERTY written once when the widget was built, so a scale that grew every caption left every glyph beside those captions exactly where it was. The settle now re-derives them, through :func:`spacr.qt.preferences._rescale_icon_sizes`, inside the same ``apply_preferences_to_app`` step that rebuilds the sheet: 5.5 ms for the 2,122 widgets of a window with two modules open, against the 395-877 ms that step costs when the scale really changes. Nothing was added to the live half.
records.translation: 而且图标完全没有变化，这并不属于那个折衷的一部分。间距在稳定时会追上；图标却始终没有追上，因为图标尺寸既不是样式表中的值，也不是会被重新运行的 ``scaled_px`` 调用——它是在控件构建时写入一次的控件属性，所以缩放放大了每个标题，却让标题旁边的每个字形原地不动。现在，稳定时会通过 :func:`spacr.qt.preferences._rescale_icon_sizes` 在重建样式表的同一个 ``apply_preferences_to_app`` 步骤中重新推导它们：对于打开了两个模块的窗口中的 2,122 个控件，这需要 5.5 ms，而在缩放比例真正改变时，该步骤本身需要 395-877 ms。实时部分没有增加任何内容。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.live_zoom.LiveZoomFilter.settle#2
records.source: THE ICONS CATCH UP HERE TOO, and here only. They ride inside ``apply_preferences_to_app`` rather than being resized per notch, because the condition on this gesture was that it be fast without lag and the live half is the half that has to answer for it. The sweep is 5.5 ms on 2,122 widgets, so it COULD have gone in the live half -- it is here because the icons would then have grown inside spacing that had not, which is the mismatch that made the icons look wrong in the first place.

records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_datasets#4
records.source: WHICH FIELDS. A random draw in which every field of the dataset has the same chance -- the first N by name are the first plate of the first domain, which is not the dataset. SEEDED by the dataset key, so the draw is the same on every machine: a sample that changes between two people's machines is a sample nobody can talk about -- "the third field looks wrong" has to mean the same field for both of them. A dataset with a quota draws that way within each domain.
records.context: Which fields. A random draw in which every field of the dataset has the same chance -- the first N by name are the first laboratory microplate of the first domain, which is not the dataset. SEEDED by the dataset structured-data name, so the draw is the same on every machine: a sample that changes between two people's machines is a sample nobody can talk about -- "the third field looks wrong" has to mean the same field for both of them. A dataset with a quota draws that way within each domain.
records.translation: 选取哪些视野。采用随机抽取，数据集中的每个视野被抽中的机会相同——按名称排列的前 N 个视野是第一个领域的第一个板，并不能代表整个数据集。以数据集键作为随机种子，因此每台机器上的抽取结果都相同：如果样本在两个人的机器上不一样，就没有人能讨论它——“第三个视野看起来不对”必须对两个人来说指的是同一个视野。带有配额的数据集会在每个领域内按这种方式抽取。

records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_datasets#5
records.source: THE LAYOUT IS MAKE MASKS' OWN: images at the top of the folder, masks in `masks/` beneath them, which is what `curation_queue.detect_layout` calls `nested` and the layout spaCR uses everywhere. records.source: THREE INVERSIONS LIVE HERE AND THEY DO DIFFERENT THINGS (items 435 and 419 point 9). :func:`invert_intensity` is the photographic complement of an IMAGE -- ``dtype_max - value``, what a viewer's Invert does, exactly reversible on every integer dtype -- and it is what the Make Masks screen's "Invert image" draws with. :func:`invert_for_detection` reflects an image about its OWN range instead, and is what the screen's "Invert for detection" hands the detectors; its docstring has the measurement that says why a detector cannot use the complement, and it is NOT a duplicate to be merged away. :func:`invert_mask` flips a LABEL image's foreground and background; on an ordinary field that gives one object covering the frame, which is why it was reported as doing nothing.
records.context: Three inversions live here and they do different things (items 435 and 419 point 9). :func:`invert_intensity` is the photographic complement of an IMAGE -- ``dtype_max - value``, what a viewer's Invert does, exactly reversible on every integer dtype -- and it is what the Make Masks screen's "Invert image" draws with. :func:`invert_for_detection` reflects an image about its OWN range instead, and is what the screen's "Invert for detection" hands the detectors; its docstring has the measurement that says why a detector cannot use the complement, and it is NOT a duplicate to be merged away. :func:`invert_mask` flips a LABEL image's foreground and background; on an ordinary microscope field of view that gives one object covering the frame, which is why it was reported as doing nothing.
records.translation: 这里有三种反转，它们的作用各不相同（条目 435 以及条目 419 第 9 点）。:func:`invert_intensity` 是图像的摄影学补色——``dtype_max - value``，即查看器的 Invert 所做的操作，在所有整数 dtype 上都可以精确还原——Make Masks 界面的 "Invert image" 就是用它绘制的。:func:`invert_for_detection` 则是把图像关于其自身的取值范围进行镜像，界面的 "Invert for detection" 交给检测器的就是它；其文档字符串中给出了说明为什么检测器不能使用补色的测量结果，而且它并不是一个应当合并掉的重复函数。:func:`invert_mask` 翻转标签图像的前景和背景；在普通视野上，这会得到一个覆盖整个画面的对象，这就是它曾被报告为不起任何作用的原因。

records.source: In place is sound for both, which is why there is no convert step. A sibling set differs from a nested one only in where its masks folder is, so passing that folder is the whole change. A bundle is rewritten with every key it already had kept, ``masks`` replaced, and the two keys derived from the masks -- ``outlines`` and ``ismanual`` -- brought up to date with it (see :func:`save_seg_bundle`); that is what the external curation tool did to the same files, less its stale outlines. A convert step would have been a second copy of every field, and the curator would have had to remember which copy was the truth.
records.context: In place is sound for both, which is why there is no convert step. A sibling set differs from a nested one only in where its masks folder is, so passing that folder is the whole change. A bundle is rewritten with every structured-data name it already had kept, ``masks`` replaced, and the two structured-data names derived from the masks -- ``outlines`` and ``ismanual`` -- brought up to date with it (see :func:`save_seg_bundle`); that is what the external curation tool did to the same files, less its stale outlines. A convert step would have been a second copy of every microscope field of view, and the curator would have had to remember which copy was the truth.
records.translation: 对这两者而言，原位编辑都是可靠的，这就是没有转换步骤的原因。sibling 数据集与 nested 数据集的唯一区别在于其掩膜文件夹的位置，因此传入该文件夹就是全部的改动。包在重写时会保留其原有的每个键，替换 ``masks``，并使由掩膜派生的两个键——``outlines`` 和 ``ismanual``——随之更新（参见 :func:`save_seg_bundle`）；这与外部整理工具对同一批文件所做的处理相同，只是去掉了其过时的轮廓。转换步骤会为每个视野生成第二份副本，而整理者还得记住哪一份才是真实数据。

records.context: A view is one visit to one application view: it begins when the application view is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another application view (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Pins last for the view: returning to the application view with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.
records.translation: 一个“视图”是对某个界面的一次访问：它在界面显示时开始（:meth:`begin_view`，来自其 ``showEvent``），在用户转到另一个界面而使其隐藏时结束（:meth:`end_view`，来自其 ``hideEvent``）。最小化窗口不会结束视图——所有者只传递非自发事件。固定状态在视图期间有效：返回到仍开着实时预览的界面时，会再次折叠周围区域，这与新进入该布局时的情况相同。

records.context: :data:`MODEL_5PL` fits :func:`five_parameter_logistic`, a 4PL with one more parameter that lets the curve approach its two plateaus at different rates. Real dose–responses are asymmetric — receptor occupancy with cooperativity, anything read through a saturating stain — and **a 4PL fitted to an asymmetric curve does not fail, it moves the EC50**: on the calibration series in ``tests/qt/test_dose_response_fits_an_asymmetric_curve.py`` a symmetric fit to a curve whose true EC50 is 1.0 reports 0.67, with a tight interval and an R² of 0.997.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#26
records.source: It is nonetheless **not the default**, and that is a decision rather than an oversight. The fifth parameter trades off against the Hill slope — many (slope, asymmetry) pairs draw nearly the same curve — so on the eight or ten concentrations a plate actually carries it is weakly identified, and the profile interval it produces is correspondingly wider. The module therefore offers it, fits it **from the 4PL solution** so the asymmetric search starts at the symmetric answer, and reports an extra-sum-of-squares F test of the one added parameter in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` so a reader can see whether the asymmetry was worth what it cost.
records.context: It is nonetheless **not the default**, and that is a decision rather than an oversight. The fifth parameter trades off against the Hill slope — many (slope, asymmetry) pairs draw nearly the same curve — so on the eight or ten concentrations a plate actually carries it is weakly identified, and the profile interval it produces is correspondingly wider. The module therefore offers it, fits it **from the 4PL solution** so the asymmetric search starts at the symmetric answer, and reports an extra-sum-of-squares F test of the one added parameter in :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` so a reader can see whether the asymmetry was worth what it cost.
records.translation: 尽管如此，它**不是默认选项**，这是一个决定而不是疏忽。第五个参数与 Hill 斜率相互抵消——许多（斜率，非对称性）组合画出的曲线几乎相同——因此在一块板实际包含的八到十个浓度上，它很难被识别，所得的轮廓区间也相应更宽。因此，本模块把它作为选项提供，**从 4PL 的解开始**拟合它，使非对称搜索从对称解出发，并在 :attr:`DoseResponseResult.asymmetry_p` 中报告对这一个新增参数的额外平方和 F 检验，以便读者判断非对称性是否值得其代价。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
